fields.Description: Gate G4.2 (owner PR 5, phase 4, dataset C1, criterion C1.2): the Model Development Agent's tool paths read 0 holdout labels during a scenario C1 session. On the truth suite's W1-signal world, one planning session from the renewal goal (D5-45) until the plan is presented: 0 MJ: ML Prediction Units, 0 MJ: ML Evaluation Protocols and 0 MJ: ML Training Runs rows are written (no row before approval, D5-25; no training run, so the protocol's holdout-access record has 0 agent accesses); both draft Actions ran and every Action step of the session reports HoldoutRowsRead = 0; the presented plan resolves every name and names its censoring rule; each Data Scout prompt run renders the compact catalog within the 30,000-token DD-2 budget. Server transport (the agent runs as the D5-46 person); spends LLM money. Mutation: let AgentReadScope.DevelopmentRows return the unit's rows without the holdout rule -> red. Run budget 20 min (MaxExecutionTimeMS): up to four orchestrator turns at M0's 51 s maximum, with their sub-agent runs.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A C1 planning session up to present-plan writes no unit, protocol or training run and every Action step reads 0 holdout rows.
